title: approvals: the email action-link reject (ADR-0043 confirm page) records "Via action link" instead of a reason the approver typed — add a required reason field (remaining leg of #35593's "reject carries a reason")
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czKnDE6hsyXQzB9wB2

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding while building #35719 (dev report 7029076347); filed on the seat's routing. ⛔ Not a claim.

**What.** `redeemActionToken` (plugin-approvals approval-service.ts ~7945) decides a reject from the email action link with the fixed comment "Via action link". The confirm page (action-link-pages.ts form ~94) has no reason field. After #35659 and #35719, every other reject door requires a reason the person typed; this door records a canned string.

**Ask.** Add a required, non-blank reason field to the confirm page for a reject (approve stays optional), pass it through `redeemActionToken`, and translate the new copy in every locale the package ships. Pin both a reject that is refused when the reason is blank and one that succeeds with a reason.

Suggested-grade: p2 · the last door for the maintainer's requirement in #35593.
Dedupe: `approval action link reject reason`, `Via action link comment` (0 open hits).
